speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are having difficulty conceiving and experiencing discomfort during sexual activity. To help me understand your symptoms, how long have you been trying to conceive?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; your history of dyspareunia and pelvic floor tension combined with your partner's erectile difficulties suggests a possible mechanical or psychological barrier to conception. To evaluate for underlying pelvic pathology or structural issues, REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Floor_Assessment.
